text: so is the WorldLoader the same as the world_loader ?
resolution: Answered that WorldLoader and world_loader are the same core loader implementation but different entry surfaces: WorldLoader is the React/native host primitive mounted inside hmsc-int and it calls into world_loader.zig via v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig, while world_loader is also built as the standalone no-V8 binary for tools/rjit game play. No code changes were needed.
